name: Passing Word of a Threat
summary: Karnik sends you to Advisor Belgrum with a sealed note. Tell Belgrum what you witnessed and ask how to proceed while Karnik seeks answers from Hammertoe's spirit.

sections.title: Word for Advisor Belgrum
sections.body:
Historian Karnik needs you to reach Advisor Belgrum quickly. Tell him what you witnessed and ask how he wants to proceed. The sealed note explains more.

Meanwhile, Karnik speaks with Hammertoe's spirit, hoping to learn how to end the Shadowforge's doings in the Badlands. He can only pray that Hammertoe knows something that will help.

faq.q: Who sends you to Advisor Belgrum?
aliases: who starts passing word of a threat
who gives passing word of a threat
faq.answer: Historian Karnik gives you a sealed note and asks you to find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can.

faq.q: What does Karnik want from Advisor Belgrum?
faq.answer: Karnik wants you to tell Belgrum what you witnessed and ask how he wants to proceed. The note explains more.

faq.q: What is Historian Karnik doing while you deliver the note?
faq.answer: As you deliver the note, Karnik speaks with Hammertoe's spirit, hoping to learn how to stop the Shadowforge in the Badlands.

faq.q: What quest comes before Passing Word of a Threat?
aliases: passing word of a threat previous quest
faq.answer: Passing Word of a Threat follows Prospect of Faith, when you bring Hammertoe's amulet to Karnik in Ironforge.
